headlines.title: 74-year-old Army vet sues hospital after surgeons amputate wrong leg
headlines.description: An Ohio woman is suing a hospital, accusing its doctors of amputating the wrong leg. Sharon Jacks, 74, filed a lawsuit this month in Washington County Common Pleas Court in Marietta, Ohio, claiming that her left leg was amputated at Selby General Hospital in September 2025.

headlines.title: New Progress Update on Breast Cancer Vaccine Research
headlines.description: Vaccines are one of the fastest growing areas in cancer research, and one industry research firm projects that the market for personalized cancer vaccines could reach more than $8 billion a year by 2034. Former NBC News correspondent Kristen Dahlgren and cancer researcher Dr. Karen Knudsen, CEO of The Parker Institute, join TODAY to share the latest updates on where breast cancer vaccines stand and what it means for treatment in the future.

headlines.title: New Weight Loss Drug Shows Promising Results Over GLP-1s
headlines.description: New trial data for the weight loss drug called retatrutide shows it helped people living with obesity and type 2 diabetes lose up to 50lbs or 21% of their body weight. Those without diabetes lost up to 70lbs, 25% of body weight, making it the most weight loss ever recorded in a drug trial for diabetes patients. NBC medical contributor Dr. Natalie Azar joins TODAY to break down how the drug compares to GLP-1s.

headlines.title: Looming changes to Medicaid work requirements spark concern with patients and caregivers
headlines.description: New Medicaid work requirements are set to take effect at the beginning of 2027 and the non-partisan Congressional Budget Office says the changes could leave 8 million more people across the country without health insurance. It has patients and caregivers concerned about their futures. NBC News' Julie Tsirkin reports.

headlines.title: End-Of-Year Doctor Appointments: How to Get One, What to Say
headlines.description: The final months of the year are approaching, so it’s time to squeeze in end-of-year doctor's appointments. Family physician Dr. Jen Caudle stops by TODAY with tips on how to get the most out of your appointments, including getting the appointment, knowing when to get a second opinion, bringing a list of symptoms to your appointment, and more.
